name: Cloud
attack_surface: Instance metadata endpoints, API credentials, identity trust policy files, storage bucket ACLs
common_misconfigurations: Exposed instance access keys in client-side code repositories
validation_methods: Test credential permissions using cloud administration CLI tools
Inspect metadata service configurations via local container requests
evidence_requirements: Shell trace of CLI credential check commands output
Raw response from instance metadata readout request
false_positive_indicators: Mocked credentials in example code that do not correspond to real accounts
reporting_guidance: High priority focus area. Cross-tenant access or write access to cloud resources represents a critical vulnerability.
